text: The Nominating Panel - Property Standards Committee will select candidates to be interviewed for appointment to the Property Standards Committee. The Nominating Panel will conduct interviews at its next meeting and recommend one candidate to City Council for appointment.

The Nominating Panel - Property Standards Committee: 1. Selected the following candidates for interview for appointment to the Property Standards Committee: Candidate PSC2-189 Candidate PSC2-228 Candidate PSC2-234 Candidate PSC2-237 2. Directed that Confidential Attachments 1a, 1b and 2 to the report (June 4, 2024) from the City Clerk remain confidential in their entirety as they relate to personal matters about identfiable individuals being considered for appointment to the Property Standards Committee.
